_comment: ViArc-2 harness config — single source of truth (visible on LXC 114 + kernel env). Plan: knowledge/viarc_master_plan.vsm

kernel_env._note: v10 calibration: K=4+LOO=2 concentrated on the 240 scored test tasks (~82s x 240 = 5.5h < 9.5h guard); runtime decide_budget may shed to 0 under pressure (A0.1); ceiling K<=8 LOO<=2 (ratified)

sft.method: LoRA r=16 alpha=32 attn q/k/v/o fp16(T4) seq_len=512 lr=1e-4 calib-150
sft._seq_note: v12 (Oct19 smoke): 768 OOMed on T4 at loss upcast (1.16GiB logits.float); ladder validated 512 fits clean with ~5GiB headroom once the traceback-retention leak was fixed. Ratified intent stays 512 until an A100 slot exists.
sft._precision_note: v11 (Oct19 incident): auto chose bf16=True on T4 (is_bf16_supported() lies on Turing); ratified intent = fp16 on T4/Turing (docstring sft_train). Forced.
sft._workers_note: v11: pre-tokenized RAM data — workers buy nothing; fork-after-CUDA is the Oct19 12h-silence deadlock class.
sft._save_note: v11: save-at-end-only lost every interrupted run; partial ckpts survive kills. v12 calib: 50 so the 150-step cap persists 3 ckpts (total=2 keeps last).
sft._max_steps_note: v12 CALIB (S5 2026-10-19, re-scope tras smoke): 150 steps ~5h train — adapter candidato + curva de loss + velocidad real. Corpus completo = post-entry (10-27..11-01), sólo si el gate del calib pasa.
sft.est_iter_hours: CALIBRATED v12 (Oct19 smoke): ~65s/opt-step @ seq=256 on T4 → ~130s @ 512 → 150 steps ≈ 5.5h train + ~40min setup. Full 1-epoch @512 ≈ 25h (multi-night, post-entry only).
